extraction_scope: Worker-6 final source-reviewed mechanism record from current paper XML/PDF text, figures, and tables; mechanism claims are bounded and do not resolve the database sequence gap.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CaThi permeabilizes Candida plasma membranes after treatment at the relevant IC50 concentrations; Sytox green fluorescence was observed across the tested yeasts and Table 2 reports fluorescent-cell percentages for control and CaThi conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CaThi in Candida species tested in this paper
mechanism_claims.limitations: Permeabilization percentages vary by species; this does not establish exact sequence identity or all downstream intracellular targets.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CaThi induced detectable ROS production in C. tropicalis under the tested conditions, while the paper states ROS was not detected for the other Candida species tested.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CaThi in Candida tropicalis, with negative/unsupported generalization to other tested Candida species
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS involvement is species-specific in the reported evidence and should not be generalized to all Candida activity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FITC-tagged CaThi entered C. albicans and C. tropicalis cells; co-localization with DAPI in C. tropicalis supports a possible nuclear-localized target, but the paper frames this as suggestive rather than resolved.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CaThi-FITC localization in C. albicans and C. tropicalis

source_locators.locator: xml:sec=10:Localization of CaThi in yeast cells

mechanism_claims.limitations: Possible nuclear target is not a definitive molecular target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CaThi and fluconazole together increased Candida growth inhibition compared with single-agent controls in Table 3, supporting phenotypic synergy but not resolving a molecular synergy mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CaThi plus fluconazole against six Candida species
mechanism_claims.limitations: Synergy is phenotypic; the paper hypothesizes membrane facilitation but says further studies are needed to clearly unravel the mechanism.

unresolved_mechanism_limits: Exact sequence/modification identity is unresolved in local current-paper material.
Figure-only morphology/viability images were not used to fabricate unsupported exact values outside the text/table evidence.
